name: もちもちおにぎり🍙skeb募集中！
description: 好きな時に好きなものを好きなだけ/ほぼ原神/自作発言、無断転載、AI学習など❌ / skeb→ https://skeb.jp/@mochioni113

works.body:
Hello もちもちおにぎりさん, it's nice to meet you. Thank you for the appeal! もちもちおにぎりさん's illustrations are wonderful, especially the gnsn illustrations. I'd be happy if I could request an illustration of my character <Aiyu> like stated in the appeal. 

https://www.deviantart.com/stash/298t6rh0oj6

Please view Aiyu's images via the above URL. 
Aiyu is a cheerful idol with an underwater and heart theme. Her personality is energetic and cute, but a bit two-faced too.

I really like もちもちおにぎりさん's illustrations that have a dynamic sense of lighting, so I would be happy if Aiyu could be drawn in an illustration that uses lighting. I will leave the composition and other details up to you.

If possible, please deliver a PSD file with the sign layer separate from the illustration. Thank you for your consideration.
